[1mManual/Binary installation:[22m
  • ImageMagick:
    1. Download the AppImage from https://imagemagick.org/script/download.php#linux
    2. Make it executable and place it on your PATH:
       chmod +x ImageMagick-*.AppImage && sudo mv ImageMagick-*.AppImage /usr/local/bin/magick
    3. Run "magick -version" to verify
